description: Every known vulnerability in one vendor product, such as an operating system, browser, server, CMS or appliance, most urgent first, with the affected versions and fixes. The vendor is optional: with only a product name, a clear match is answered directly and otherwise the candidates are listed. Give a version to learn which entries affect it and the lowest upgrade that clears them.

only_affected.description: With version, list only the entries that affect it.

product.description: The product name, such as WordPress, nginx, Tomcat or FortiOS.

vendor.description: Optional vendor name, such as Apache or Fortinet.

version.description: Optional exact version to check, such as 6.4.2.

name: get_product

candidates.description: When the product name is ambiguous: vendor and product pairs to call again with.

title: Look up a product
